s.d: πιστεύω, [in LXX chiefly for אמן hi. ;] 1. intrans., to have faith (in), to believe; in cl., with accusative, dative, in NT also with prep, (on the significance of the various constructions, see M, Pr., 67f.; Vau. on [[romans 4 5|Rom.4:5;]] Ellic. on [[1-timothy 1 16|1Ti.1:16;]] Abbott, JV, 19-80): absol., [[matthew 24 23|Mat.24:23, 26]] [[mark 13 21|Mrk.13:21]], [[1-corinthians 11 18|1Co.11:18]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 13 41|Act.13:41]], [[1-corinthians 13 7|1Co.13:7]]; with dative of person(s) (to believe what one says), Mrk.16:[13, 14], [[1-john 4 1|1Jn.4:1]]; τ. ψεύδει, [[2-thessalonians 2 11|2Th.2:11;]] περί . . . ὅτι, [[john 9 18|Jhn.9:18;]] esp. and most frequently with reference to religious belief: absol., [[matthew 8 13|Mat.8:13]], [[mark 5 36|Mrk.5:36]], [[luke 8 50|Luk.8:50]], [[john 11 40|Jhn.11:40]], al.; before ὅτι, [[matthew 9 28|Mat.9:28]], al.; with dative (see supr., and cf. DB, i, 829a), [[john 3 12|Jhn.3:12 5:24 6:30 8:31]], [[acts 16 34|Act.16:34]], [[galatians 3 6|Gal.3:6]]" (LXX), [[2-timothy 1 12|2Ti.1:12]], [[1-john 5 10|1Jn.5:10]], al.; with prep., (expressing personal trust and reliance as distinct from mere credence or belief; see M, Pr., l.with; DB, i, 829b), to believe in or on: ἐν (Psa.77 (78):22, al.), [[mark 1 15|Mrk.1:15]] (see Swete, in l.); εἰς, [[matthew 18 6|Mat.18:6]], [[john 2 11|Jhn.2:11]] (see Westc., in l.), and freq., [[acts 10 43|Act.10:43 19:4]], [[romans 10 14|Rom.10:14]], [[galatians 2 16|Gal.2:16]], [[philippians 1 29|Php.1:29]], I [[john 5 10|Jhn.5:10]], [[1-peter 1 8|1Pe.1:8]]; εἰς τ. ὄνομα, [[john 1 12|Jhn.1:12 2:23 3:18]], [[1-john 5 13|1Jn.5:13]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[matthew 27 42|Mat.27:42]], [[acts 9 42|Act.9:42 11:17 16:31 22:19]], [[romans 4 5|Rom.4:5]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[romans 9 33|Rom.9:33]] (LXX) 10:11 (ib.), [[1-timothy 1 16|1Ti.1:16]], [[1-peter 2 6|1Pe.2:6]]" (LXX) ; ptcp. pres., οἱ π., as subst., [[acts 2 44|Act.2:44]], [[romans 3 22|Rom.3:22]], [[1-corinthians 1 21|1Co.1:21]], al.; aor., Mrk.16:[16], [[acts 4 32|Act.4:32]]; pf., [[acts 19 18|Act.19:18 21:20]] (on Johannine use of the tenses of π., see Westc, Epp. Jo., 120). 2. Trans., to entrust: with accusative and dative, [[luke 16 11|Luk.16:11]], [[john 2 24|Jhn.2:24]]; pass., to be entrusted with: with accusative, [[romans 3 2|Rom.3:2]], [[1-corinthians 9 17|1Co.9:17]], [[galatians 2 7|Gal.2:7]], [[1-thessalonians 2 4|1Th.2:4]] (see Lft., Notes, 21f.), [[1-timothy 1 11|1Ti.1:11]], [[titus 1 3|Tit.1:3]]. (AS)

πιστικός, -ή, -όν (πίστις), 1. having the gift of persuasion (Plat., Gorg., 455A). 2. (a) of persons, faithful, trusty (Plut.); (b) of things, trustworthy, genuine: νάρδος π., [[mark 14 3|Mrk.14:3]], [[john 12 3|Jhn.12:3]]. † (AS)

πίστις, -εως, ἡ (πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמוּנָה ;] 1. in active sense, faith, belief, trust, confidence, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: [[matthew 8 10|Mat.8:10]], [[luke 5 20|Luk.5:20]], [[acts 14 9|Act.14:9]], [[romans 1 8|Rom.1:8]], [[1-corinthians 2 5|1Co.2:5]], [[2-corinthians 1 24|2Co.1:24]], [[1-timothy 1 5|1Ti.1:5]], al.; with genitive obj., [[mark 11 22|Mrk.11:22]], [[acts 3 16|Act.3:16]], [[romans 3 22|Rom.3:22]], [[galatians 2 16|Gal.2:16]], [[ephesians 3 12|Eph.3:12]], [[james 2 1|Jas.2:1]], al.; with prep., ἐν, [[romans 3 25|Rom.3:25]], [[galatians 3 26|Gal.3:26]], [[ephesians 1 15|Eph.1:15]], [[colossians 1 24|Col.1:24]], [[1-timothy 1 14|1Ti.1:14 3:13]], [[2-timothy 1 13|2Ti.1:13 3:15]], [[2-peter 1 1|2Pe.1:1]]; εἰς, [[acts 20 21|Act.20:21 24:24 26:18]], [[colossians 2 5|Col.2:5]], [[1-peter 1 21|1Pe.1:21]]; πρός, [[1-thessalonians 1 8|1Th.1:8]], Phm 5; ἐπί, with accusative [[hebrews 6 1|Heb.6:1;]] ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), [[1-corinthians 16 13|1Co.16:13]], [[1-corinthians 13 5|1Co.13:5]], [[1-timothy 2 15|1Ti.2:15]]; ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5 16:26]]; ὁ ἐκ π., [[romans 3 26|Rom.3:26 4:16]], [[galatians 3 12|Gal.3:12]]; διὰ (τῆς) π., [[romans 3 30|Rom.3:30]], [[galatians 2 16|Gal.2:16]], [[philippians 3 9|Php.3:9]]. By meton., objectively, that which is the object or content of belief, the faith: [[acts 6 7|Act.6:7 14:22]], [[galatians 1 23|Gal.1:23 3:23 6:10]], [[philippians 1 26|Php.1:26, 27]] Ju 3, 20, and perh. also [[acts 13 8|Act.13:8 16:5]], [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5]] [[romans 16 26|and 16:26]] (see supr.), [[1-corinthians 16 13|1Co.16:13]], [[colossians 1 23|Col.1:23]], [[2-thessalonians 3 2|2Th.3:2]] (Lft., Notes, 125), [[1-timothy 1 19|1Ti.1:19 3:9 4:1, 6 5:8]] 6:10, 12, [[2-timothy 3 8|2Ti.3:8 4:7]] [[titus 1 4|Tit.1:4, 13 3:15]], [[1-peter 5 9|1Pe.5:9]]. 2. In passive sense, (a) fidelity, faithfulness: [[matthew 23 23|Mat.23:23]], [[galatians 5 22|Gal.5:22]]; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3;]] (b) objectively, plighted faith, a pledge of fidelity: [[1-timothy 5 12|1Ti.5:12.]] (On the various shades of meaning in which the word is used in NT, see esp. ICC on [[romans 1 17|Rom.1:17]], pp. 31ff.; Lft., Ga., 154ff.; Stevens, Th. NT, 422, 515ff.; DB, i, 830ff.; Cremer, see word) (AS)

πίστις, -εως, ἡ (πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמוּנָה ;] 1. in active sense, faith, belief, trust, confidence, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: [[matthew 8 10|Mat.8:10]], [[luke 5 20|Luk.5:20]], [[acts 14 9|Act.14:9]], [[romans 1 8|Rom.1:8]], [[1-corinthians 2 5|1Co.2:5]], [[2-corinthians 1 24|2Co.1:24]], [[1-timothy 1 5|1Ti.1:5]], al.; with genitive obj., [[mark 11 22|Mrk.11:22]], [[acts 3 16|Act.3:16]], [[romans 3 22|Rom.3:22]], [[galatians 2 16|Gal.2:16]], [[ephesians 3 12|Eph.3:12]], [[james 2 1|Jas.2:1]], al.; with prep., ἐν, [[romans 3 25|Rom.3:25]], [[galatians 3 26|Gal.3:26]], [[ephesians 1 15|Eph.1:15]], [[colossians 1 24|Col.1:24]], [[1-timothy 1 14|1Ti.1:14 3:13]], [[2-timothy 1 13|2Ti.1:13 3:15]], [[2-peter 1 1|2Pe.1:1]]; εἰς, [[acts 20 21|Act.20:21 24:24 26:18]], [[colossians 2 5|Col.2:5]], [[1-peter 1 21|1Pe.1:21]]; πρός, [[1-thessalonians 1 8|1Th.1:8]], Phm 5; ἐπί, with accusative [[hebrews 6 1|Heb.6:1;]] ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), [[1-corinthians 16 13|1Co.16:13]], [[1-corinthians 13 5|1Co.13:5]], [[1-timothy 2 15|1Ti.2:15]]; ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5 16:26]]; ὁ ἐκ π., [[romans 3 26|Rom.3:26 4:16]], [[galatians 3 12|Gal.3:12]]; διὰ (τῆς) π., [[romans 3 30|Rom.3:30]], [[galatians 2 16|Gal.2:16]], [[philippians 3 9|Php.3:9]]. By meton., objectively, that which is the object or content of belief, the faith: [[acts 6 7|Act.6:7 14:22]], [[galatians 1 23|Gal.1:23 3:23 6:10]], [[philippians 1 26|Php.1:26, 27]] Ju 3, 20, and perh. also [[acts 13 8|Act.13:8 16:5]], [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5]] [[romans 16 26|and 16:26]] (see supr.), [[1-corinthians 16 13|1Co.16:13]], [[colossians 1 23|Col.1:23]], [[2-thessalonians 3 2|2Th.3:2]] (Lft., Notes, 125), [[1-timothy 1 19|1Ti.1:19 3:9 4:1, 6 5:8]] 6:10, 12, [[2-timothy 3 8|2Ti.3:8 4:7]] [[titus 1 4|Tit.1:4, 13 3:15]], [[1-peter 5 9|1Pe.5:9]]. 2. In passive sense, (a) fidelity, faithfulness: [[matthew 23 23|Mat.23:23]], [[galatians 5 22|Gal.5:22]]; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3;]] (b) objectively, plighted faith, a pledge of fidelity: [[1-timothy 5 12|1Ti.5:12.]] (On the various shades of meaning in which the word is used in NT, see esp. ICC on [[romans 1 17|Rom.1:17]], pp. 31ff.; Lft., Ga., 154ff.; Stevens, Th. NT, 422, 515ff.; DB, i, 830ff.; Cremer, see word) (AS)

πιστός, -ή, -όν (πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אָמַן ;] I. Pass., to be trusted or believed; 1. of persons, trusty, faithful : [[matthew 24 45|Mat.24:45 25:21, 23]] [[luke 12 42|Luk.12:42]], [[acts 16 15|Act.16:15]], [[1-corinthians 4 2|1Co.4:2 4:17 7:25]], [[ephesians 1 1|Eph.1:1 6:21]], [[colossians 1 2|Col.1:2, 7 4:7, 9]], [[1-timothy 1 12|1Ti.1:12]], [[2-timothy 2 2|2Ti.2:2]], [[hebrews 2 17|Heb.2:17 3:2, 5]], [[1-peter 5 12|1Pe.5:12]], [[revelation 2 13|Rev.2:13 19:11]]; of God, [[1-corinthians 1 9|1Co.1:9 10:13]], [[2-corinthians 1 18|2Co.1:18]], [[1-thessalonians 5 24|1Th.5:24]], [[2-thessalonians 3 3|2Th.3:3]], [[hebrews 10 23|Heb.10:23 11:11]], [[2-timothy 2 13|2Ti.2:13]], [[1-john 1 9|1Jn.1:9]], [[1-peter 4 19|1Pe.4:19]]; before ἐν, [[luke 16 10|Luk.16:10-12 19:17]], [[1-timothy 3 11|1Ti.3:11]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[matthew 25 23|Mat.25:23;]] ἄχρι θανάτου, [[revelation 2 10|Rev.2:10;]] ὁ μάρτυς ὁ π., [[revelation 1 5|Rev.1:5;]] id. καὶ ἀληθινός, [[revelation 3 14|Rev.3:14.]] 2. Of things, trustworthy, reliable, sure: [[acts 13 34|Act.13:34]], [[1-timothy 1 15|1Ti.1:15 3:1 4:9]], [[2-timothy 2 11|2Ti.2:11]], [[titus 1 9|Tit.1:9 3:8]], [[revelation 21 5|Rev.21:5 22:6]]. II. Act., believing, trusting, relying: [[acts 16 1|Act.16:1]], [[2-corinthians 6 15|2Co.6:15]], [[galatians 3 9|Gal.3:9]], [[1-timothy 4 10|1Ti.4:10 5:16 6:2]], [[titus 1 6|Tit.1:6]], [[revelation 17 14|Rev.17:14]]; pl., [[acts 10 45|Act.10:45]], [[1-timothy 4 3|1Ti.4:3 4:12]]; opposite to ἄπιστος, [[john 20 27|Jhn.20:27;]] π. εἰς θεόν, [[1-peter 1 21|1Pe.1:21;]] π. ποιεῖν, III Jn 5. (On the difficulty of choosing in some cases between the active and the passive meaning, see Lft., Gal., 157.) † (AS)

πιστόω, -ῶ (πιστός), [in LXX chiefly for אָמֵן ni. ;] to make trustworthy (Thuc., [[1-kings 1 36|3Ki.1:36]]), hence, to establish ([[1-chronicles 17 14|1Ch.17:14]]). Pass. and mid., to be assured of: with accusative of thing(s), [[2-timothy 3 14|2Ti.3:14.]]† (AS)

πλανάω, -ῶ (πλάνη), [in LXX chiefly for תָּעָה ;] to cause to wander, lead astray. Pass., to go astray, wander: [[matthew 18 12|Mat.18:12-13]] [[hebrews 11 38|Heb.11:38]], [[1-peter 2 25|1Pe.2:25]] (cf. [[isaiah 53 6|Isa.53:6]]). Metaphorical, to lead astray, deceive: with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 24 4|Mat.24:4-5, 11 24:24]], [[mark 13 5|Mrk.13:5-6]], [[john 7 12|Jhn.7:12]], [[2-timothy 3 13|2Ti.3:13;]] [[1-john 1 8|1Jn.1:8]] [[john 2 26|Jn 2:26]] [[john 3 7|Jn 3:7]], [[revelation 2 20|Rev.2:20 12:9 13:14 19:20 20:3, 8 20:10]]; pass., to be led astray, to err: [[matthew 22 29|Mat.22:29]], [[mark 12 24|Mrk.12:24, 27]], [[luke 21 8|Luk.21:8]], [[john 7 47|Jhn.7:47]], [[2-timothy 3 13|2Ti.3:13]], [[titus 3 3|Tit.3:3]], [[hebrews 5 2|Heb.5:2]], [[2-peter 2 15|2Pe.2:15]], [[revelation 18 23|Rev.18:23]]; τ. καρδίᾳ, [[hebrews 3 10|Heb.3:10;]] ἀπὸ τ. ἀληθείας, [[james 5 19|Jas.5:19;]]μὴ πλανᾶσθε, [[1-corinthians 6 9|1Co.6:9 15:33]], [[galatians 6 7|Gal.6:7.]] [[james 1 16|Jas.1:16]] (cf. ἀπο-πλανάω).† (AS)

πλάνη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX: [[proverbs 14 8|Pro.14:8]] (מִרְמָה), Wis.1:12, al ;] a wandering. Metaphorical, a going astray, an error (in NT always with respect to morals or religion): [[matthew 27 64|Mat.27:64]], [[romans 1 27|Rom.1:27]], [[ephesians 4 14|Eph.4:14]], [[1-thessalonians 2 3|1Th.2:3]], [[2-thessalonians 2 11|2Th.2:11]], [[james 5 20|Jas.5:20]], [[2-peter 2 18|2Pe.2:18 3:17 3:1-18]]; [[1-john 4 6|1Jn.4:6]], Ju 11.† (AS)
πλανήτης, -ου, ὁ (πλανάω), [in LXX: [[hosea 9 17|Hos.9:17]] (נָדַד) * ;] = πλάνης, a wanderer: ἀστέρες π. (cl. planets), wandering stars, Ju 13 (WH, mg., -τες).† (AS)

πλάνος, -ον [in LXX: [[job 19 4|Job.19:4]] (מְשׁוּגָה), [[jeremiah 23 32|Jer.23:32]] * ;] 1. wandering. 2. leading astray, deceiving: πνεύματα π., [[1-timothy 4 1|1Ti.4:1.]] As subst., ὁ π., a deceiver, impostor: [[matthew 27 63|Mat.27:63]], [[2-corinthians 6 8|2Co.6:8 6:1-18]] [[2-john 1 7|2Jn.1:7]].† (AS)
πλάξ, -ακός, ἡ [in LXX for לוּחַ ;] anything flat and broad. 1. a plain (poët.). 2. In late writers (Luc., al.), a flat stone, a tablet: [[2-corinthians 3 3|2Co.3:3]], [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]].† (AS)
πλάσμα, -τος, τό (πλάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for יֵצֶר ;] that which is moulded or formed : [[romans 9 20|Rom.9:20]] (LXX).† (AS)
πλάσσω [in LXX chiefly for יָצַר ;] to form, mould: [[romans 9 26|Rom.9:26]] (LXX), [[1-timothy 2 13|1Ti.2:13.]]† (AS)
πλαστός, -ή, -όν (πλάσσω), 1. formed, moulded (Hes., Plat., al.). 2. Metaphorical, made up, fabricated, feigned (Hdt., Xen., al.): [[2-peter 2 3|2Pe.2:3.]]† (AS)

πλατεία, -ας, ἡ, see: πλατύς. πλατύς, -εῖα, -ύ [in LXX for רָחָב ;] broad: [[matthew 7 13|Mat.7:13.]] As subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for רָחָב ;] a street: [[matthew 6 5|Mat.6:5 12:19]]" (LXX), [[mark 6 56|Mrk.6:56]], WH, mg., [[luke 10 10|Luk.10:10 13:26 14:21]], [[acts 5 15|Act.5:15]], [[revelation 11 8|Rev.11:8 21:21 22:2]].† (AS)

πλάτος, -ους, τό [in LXX chiefly for רֹחַב ;] breadth: [[ephesians 3 18|Eph.3:18]], [[revelation 21 16|Rev.21:16]]; τ. π. τῆς γῆς ([[habakkuk 1 6|Hab.1:6]], מֶרְחָב), [[revelation 20 9|Rev.20:9.]]† (AS)

πλατύνω (πλατύς), [in LXX chiefly for רָחַב hi. ;] to make broad, enlarge, extend: with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 23 5|Mat.23:5.]] Metaphorical (cf. [[psalms 119 32|Psa.119:32]], al.), pass., ἡ καρδία, [[2-corinthians 6 11|2Co.6:11;]] ὑμεῖς, [[2-corinthians 6 13|2Co.6:13.]]† (AS)

πλατύς, -εῖα, -ύ [in LXX for רָחָב ;] broad: [[matthew 7 13|Mat.7:13.]] As subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for רָחָב ;] a street: [[matthew 6 5|Mat.6:5 12:19]]" (LXX), [[mark 6 56|Mrk.6:56]], WH, mg., [[luke 10 10|Luk.10:10 13:26 14:21]], [[acts 5 15|Act.5:15]], [[revelation 11 8|Rev.11:8 21:21 22:2]].† (AS)

πλέγμα, -τος, τό (πλέκω), [in Aq., Th.: [[isaiah 28 5|Isa.28:5]] * ;] what is woven or twisted (as basket-work, nets, etc.); a braiding (sc. τριχῶν, cf. [[1-peter 3 3|1Pe.3:3]]) : pl., [[1-timothy 2 9|1Ti.2:9.]]† (AS)

πλεῖστος, πλείων, see: πολύς. πολύς, πολλή, πολύ, [in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;] 1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, [[acts 11 21|Act.11:21;]] ὄχλος, [[mark 5 24|Mrk.5:24;]] θερισμός, [[matthew 9 37|Mat.9:37;]] χόρτος, [[john 6 10|Jhn.6:10;]] χρόνος, [[matthew 25 19|Mat.25:19;]] γογγυσμός, [[john 7 12|Jhn.7:12;]] πόνος, [[colossians 4 13|Col.4:13;]] δόξα, [[matthew 24 30|Mat.24:30;]] σιγή, [[acts 21 40|Act.21:40;]] pl., προφῆται, [[matthew 13 17|Mat.13:17;]] ὄχλοι, [[matthew 4 25|Mat.4:25;]] δαιμόνια, [[mark 1 34|Mrk.1:34;]] δυνάμεις, [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22]], 2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22]], [[mark 2 2|Mrk.2:2]], al.; with genitive partit., [[matthew 3 7|Mat.3:7]], [[luke 1 16|Luk.1:16]], al.; before ἐκ, [[john 7 31|Jhn.7:31]], [[acts 17 12|Act.17:12]]; with art., οἱ π., the many, [[matthew 24 12|Mat.24:12]], [[romans 12 5|Rom.12:5]], [[1-corinthians 10 17|1Co.10:17, 33]] [[2-corinthians 2 17|2Co.2:17]]; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., Notes, 291), [[romans 5 15|Rom.5:15, 19]]; neut. pl., πολλά: [[matthew 13 3|Mat.13:3]], [[mark 5 26|Mrk.5:26]], al.; accusative with adverbial force, [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45]], [[romans 16 6|Rom.16:6]] (Deiss., LAE, 317), [[1-corinthians 16 12|1Co.16:12]], [[james 3 2|Jas.3:2]], al.; neut. sing., πολύ: [[luke 12 48|Luk.12:48;]] adverbially, [[mark 12 27|Mrk.12:27]], al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), [[matthew 26 9|Mat.26:9;]] with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, [[2-corinthians 8 22|2Co.8:22;]] πολλῷ πλείους, [[john 4 41|Jhn.4:41.]] Compar., πλείων , neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, App., 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), more, greater; 1. as adj.: [[john 15 2|Jhn.15:2]], [[acts 18 2|Act.18:2]]o, [[hebrews 3 3|Heb.3:3;]] before παρά, [[hebrews 11 4|Heb.11:4]] (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., [[acts 13 31|Act.13:31]], al.; with genitive compar., [[matthew 21 36|Mat.21:36;]] with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), [[acts 4 22|Act.4:22 24:11]], al. 2. As subst., οἱ π., the greater number: [[acts 10 32|Act.10:32 27:12]], [[1-corinthians 10 5|1Co.10:5 15:6]]; also (Bl., §44, 3) others, more, the more: [[2-corinthians 2 6|2Co.2:6 4:15]], [[philippians 1 14|Php.1:14]]; πλείονα, [[luke 11 53|Luk.11:53;]] πλειον, πλέον, [[matthew 20 10|Mat.20:10]], [[2-timothy 3 9|2Ti.3:9]]; with genitive comp., [[mark 12 43|Mk 12:43]], [[luke 21 3|Luk.21:3]]; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, [[matthew 12 41|Mat.12:41;]] adverbially, [[acts 4 17|Act.4:17 20:9 24:4]]. 3. As adv., πλεῖον: before ἤ, [[luke 9 13|Luk.9:13;]] with genitive comp., [[matthew 5 20|Mat.5:20;]] πλείω: with num., [[matthew 26 53|Mat.26:53.]] Superl., πλεῖστος, -η, -ον , (a) prop., most: [[matthew 11 20|Mat.11:20 21:8]]; adverbially, τὸ π., [[1-corinthians 14 27|1Co.14:27;]] (b) elative (M, Pr., 79), very great: ὄχλος π., [[mark 4 1|Mrk.4:1.]] (AS)

πλέον, see: πολύς. πολύς, πολλή, πολύ, [in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;] 1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, [[acts 11 21|Act.11:21;]] ὄχλος, [[mark 5 24|Mrk.5:24;]] θερισμός, [[matthew 9 37|Mat.9:37;]] χόρτος, [[john 6 10|Jhn.6:10;]] χρόνος, [[matthew 25 19|Mat.25:19;]] γογγυσμός, [[john 7 12|Jhn.7:12;]] πόνος, [[colossians 4 13|Col.4:13;]] δόξα, [[matthew 24 30|Mat.24:30;]] σιγή, [[acts 21 40|Act.21:40;]] pl., προφῆται, [[matthew 13 17|Mat.13:17;]] ὄχλοι, [[matthew 4 25|Mat.4:25;]] δαιμόνια, [[mark 1 34|Mrk.1:34;]] δυνάμεις, [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22]], 2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22]], [[mark 2 2|Mrk.2:2]], al.; with genitive partit., [[matthew 3 7|Mat.3:7]], [[luke 1 16|Luk.1:16]], al.; before ἐκ, [[john 7 31|Jhn.7:31]], [[acts 17 12|Act.17:12]]; with art., οἱ π., the many, [[matthew 24 12|Mat.24:12]], [[romans 12 5|Rom.12:5]], [[1-corinthians 10 17|1Co.10:17, 33]] [[2-corinthians 2 17|2Co.2:17]]; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., Notes, 291), [[romans 5 15|Rom.5:15, 19]]; neut. pl., πολλά: [[matthew 13 3|Mat.13:3]], [[mark 5 26|Mrk.5:26]], al.; accusative with adverbial force, [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45]], [[romans 16 6|Rom.16:6]] (Deiss., LAE, 317), [[1-corinthians 16 12|1Co.16:12]], [[james 3 2|Jas.3:2]], al.; neut. sing., πολύ: [[luke 12 48|Luk.12:48;]] adverbially, [[mark 12 27|Mrk.12:27]], al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), [[matthew 26 9|Mat.26:9;]] with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, [[2-corinthians 8 22|2Co.8:22;]] πολλῷ πλείους, [[john 4 41|Jhn.4:41.]] Compar., πλείων , neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, App., 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), more, greater; 1. as adj.: [[john 15 2|Jhn.15:2]], [[acts 18 2|Act.18:2]]o, [[hebrews 3 3|Heb.3:3;]] before παρά, [[hebrews 11 4|Heb.11:4]] (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., [[acts 13 31|Act.13:31]], al.; with genitive compar., [[matthew 21 36|Mat.21:36;]] with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), [[acts 4 22|Act.4:22 24:11]], al. 2. As subst., οἱ π., the greater number: [[acts 10 32|Act.10:32 27:12]], [[1-corinthians 10 5|1Co.10:5 15:6]]; also (Bl., §44, 3) others, more, the more: [[2-corinthians 2 6|2Co.2:6 4:15]], [[philippians 1 14|Php.1:14]]; πλείονα, [[luke 11 53|Luk.11:53;]] πλειον, πλέον, [[matthew 20 10|Mat.20:10]], [[2-timothy 3 9|2Ti.3:9]]; with genitive comp., [[mark 12 43|Mk 12:43]], [[luke 21 3|Luk.21:3]]; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, [[matthew 12 41|Mat.12:41;]] adverbially, [[acts 4 17|Act.4:17 20:9 24:4]]. 3. As adv., πλεῖον: before ἤ, [[luke 9 13|Luk.9:13;]] with genitive comp., [[matthew 5 20|Mat.5:20;]] πλείω: with num., [[matthew 26 53|Mat.26:53.]] Superl., πλεῖστος, -η, -ον , (a) prop., most: [[matthew 11 20|Mat.11:20 21:8]]; adverbially, τὸ π., [[1-corinthians 14 27|1Co.14:27;]] (b) elative (M, Pr., 79), very great: ὄχλος π., [[mark 4 1|Mrk.4:1.]] (AS)
πλέκω [in LXX: [[exodus 28 14|Exo.28:14]] (עֲבֹת), [[isaiah 28 5|Isa.28:5]] (צְפִירָה)* ;] to plait, twist, weave: [[matthew 27 29|Mat.27:29]], [[mark 15 17|Mrk.15:17]], [[john 19 2|Jhn.19:2]].† (AS)

πλεονάζω (πλέον), [in LXX for עֲדַף, רָבָה, etc. ;] I. Intrans. 1. Of persons; (a) to abound in (Arist.); (b) to superabound: [[2-corinthians 8 15|2Co.8:15]] (LXX). 2. Of things, to abound, superabound: [[romans 5 20|Rom.5:20 6:1]], [[2-corinthians 4 15|2Co.4:15]], [[philippians 4 17|Php.4:17]], [[2-thessalonians 1 3|2Th.1:3]], [[2-peter 1 8|2Pe.1:8]]. II. Trans. ([[numbers 26 54|Num.26:54]], [[psalms 71 21|Psa.71:21]]; not cl, see Lft., Notes, 48 f.), to make to abound: [[1-thessalonians 3 12|1Th.3:12]] (cf. ὑπερ-πλεονάζω).† SYN.: περισσεύω, q.v (AS)

πλεονεκτέω, -ῶ (πλεονέκτης, which see), [in LXX: [[habakkuk 2 9|Hab.2:9]], [[ezekiel 22 27|Eze.22:27]] (בָּצַע), [[judges 4 11|Jdg.4:11]] B* ;] 1. intrans., to have more, to have an advantage (cl., with genitive of person(s)). 2. Trans., in late writers (see M, Pr., 65), to over­reach, defraud: with accusative of person(s), [[2-corinthians 7 2|2Co.7:2 12:17-18]]; ἐν τ. πράγματιι, [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]] (see M, Th., in l); pass., [[2-corinthians 2 11|2Co.2:11]] (as also in cl.; see LS, see word).† (AS)

πλεονέκτης, -ου, ὁ (πλέον, ἔχω), [in LXX: Sir.14:9 * ;] = ὁ θέλων πλέον ἔχειν (see MM, xx), one desirous of having more, covetous: [[1-corinthians 5 10|1Co.5:10-11 6:10]] [[ephesians 5 5|Eph.5:5]].† (AS)

πλεονεξία, -ας, ἡ (πλεονέκτης), [in LXX for בֶּצַע ;] the character and conduct of a πλεονέκτης. 1. advantage. 2. desire for advantage, grasping, aggression, cupidity, covetousness: [[luke 12 15|Luk.12:15]], [[romans 1 29|Rom.1:29]], [[2-corinthians 9 5|2Co.9:5]], [[ephesians 4 19|Eph.4:19]] (see ICC, in l) [[ephesians 5 3|Eph.5:3]], [[colossians 3 5|Col.3:5]], [[1-thessalonians 2 5|1Th.2:5]], [[2-peter 2 3|2Pe.2:3 2:14]]; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6), [[mark 7 22|Mrk.7:22.]]† SYN.: φιλαργυρία, avarice (see Tr., Syn., § xxiv) (AS)
πλευρά, -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX (frequently pl. as in Hom.) chiefly for צֵלָע ;] the side: [[matthew 27 49|Mat.27:49]] ([[WH]] R, mg.), [[john 19 34|Jhn.19:34 20:20, 25 20:27]] [[acts 12 7|Act.12:7]].† (AS)

πλέω [in LXX, before εἰς, [[jonah 1 3|Jon.1.3]] (בּוֹא), I [[esther 4 23|Est.4:23]], [[isaiah 42 10|Isa.42:10]]; before ἐπί, 4Ma.7:3; with accusative (poët.), Sir.43:24, 1Ma.13:29 (cf. [[acts 27 2|Act.27:2]], Rec.) * ;] to sail: [[luke 8 23|Luk.8:23]], [[acts 27 24|Act.27:24]]; before εἰς, [[acts 21 3|Act.21:3 27:2, 6]]; ἐπί, [[revelation 18 17|Rev.18:17]] (cf. ἀπό-, δια-, ἐκ-, κατα-, παρα-, ὑπο-πλέω).† (AS)

πληγή, ῆς, ἡ (πλήσσω), [in LXX chiefly for מַכָּה, also for מַגֵּפָה etc. ;] 1. a blow, stripe, wound: pl., [[luke 10 30|Luk.10:30 12:48]], [[acts 16 23|Act.16:23, 33]], [[2-corinthians 6 5|2Co.6:5 11:23]]; ἡ π. τ. θανάτου (RV, death-stroke), [[revelation 13 3|Rev.13:3, 12]]; τ. μαχαίρας, [[revelation 13 14|Rev.13:14.]] 2. Metaphorical, a calamity, plague: [[revelation 9 18|Rev.9:18, 20 11:6 15:1, 6 15:8 16:9, 21 18:4, 8 21:9 22:18]].† (AS)

πλῆθος, -ους, τό [in LXX chiefly for רֹב, also for הָמוֹן, etc. ;] 1. a great number, a multitude; (a) of things : ἰχθύων, [[luke 5 6|Luk.5:6]], [[john 21 6|Jhn.21:6]]; φρυγάνων, [[acts 28 3|Act.28:3;]] ἁμαρτιίῶν, [[james 5 20|Jas.5:20]], [[1-peter 4 8|1Pe.4:8]]; τ. πλήθει, in multitude, [[hebrews 11 12|Heb.11:12;]] (b) of persons: [[acts 21 22|Act.21:22]] (WH, R, om.); with genitive, [[luke 2 13|Luk.2:13]], [[john 5 3|Jhn.5:3]], [[acts 5 14|Act.5:14]]; π. πολύ (πολὺ π.), [[mark 3 7|Mrk.3:7-8;]] id. with genitive, [[luke 6 17|Luk.6:17 23:27]], [[acts 14 1|Act.14:1 17:4]] 2. Of persons, with art., the whole number, the multitude (in Plat., Thuc., Xen., al., = δῆμος, the commons, or-opposite to δῆμος-the populace) : [[acts 2 6|Act.2:6 15:30 19:9 23:7]]; τ. λαοῦ, [[acts 21 36|Act.21:36;]] τ. πόλεως, [[acts 14 4|Act.14:4;]] πᾶν τὸ π., [[acts 15 12|Act.15:12;]] with genitive, [[luke 1 10|Luk.1:10 8:37 19:37 23:1]], [[acts 4 32|Act.4:32 5:16 6:2, 5 25:24]].† (AS)

πληθύνω (causal of πληθύω, to be full, πληθύς, Ion. for πλῆθος), [in LXX chiefly for רָבָה hi. ;] 1. trans., to increase, multiply: [[2-corinthians 9 10|2Co.9:10 6:14]]" (LXX) ; pass., to be increased, to multiply: [[matthew 24 12|Mat.24:12]], [[acts 6 7|Act.6:7 7:17 9:31 12:24]]; with dative of person(s) ([[daniel 3 31|Dan LXX TH 3:31]](98) al.), [[1-peter 1 2|1Pe.1:2]], [[2-peter 1 2|2Pe.1:2]], Ju 2. 2. Intrans., to be increased, to multiply: [[acts 6 1|Act.6:1.]]† (AS)

πίμπλημι [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, also for שָׂבַע ;] trans. form in present and imperfect of πλήθω (intrans. in these tenses), which supplies the other tense forms; to fill: with accusative, [[luke 5 7|Luk.5:7;]] with accusative and genitive, [[matthew 27 48|Mat.27:48;]] pass., [[matthew 22 10|Mat.22:10]], [[acts 19 29|Act.19:29]]; of that which fills or takes possession of the mind : pass., with genitive, [[luke 1 15|Luk.1:15, 41 1:67 4:28 5:26 6:11]], [[acts 2 4|Act.2:4 3:10 4:8, 31 5:17 9:17 13:9, 45]]. Metaphorical (as in LXX for מָלֵא: [[genesis 29 27|Gen.29:27]], [[job 15 32|Job.15:32]]), to complete, fulfil: pass., of prophecy, [[luke 21 22|Luk.21:22;]] of time, [[luke 1 23|Luk.1:23, 57 2:6, 21-22]] (cf. ἐμ-πίμπλημι).† πλήθω, see: πίμπλημι SYN.: πληροφορέω, πληρόω (AS)
πλήκτης, -ου, ὁ (πλήσσω), [in Sm.: [[psalms 35 15|Psa.35:15]] * ;] a striker, brawler: [[1-timothy 3 3|1Ti.3:3]], [[titus 1 7|Tit.1:7]] (Arist., Plut., al.).† (AS)
πλήμμυρα, -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1) (πλήθω), [in LXX: π. γένεσθαι, [[job 40 18|Job.40:18]] (23) (נָהָר עָשַׁק) * ;] a flood (of sea or river) : [[luke 6 48|Luk.6:48.]]† (AS)

πλήν adv., [in LXX for רַק, בַּד, אַךְ, etc. ;] 1. introducing a clause (= ἀλλά, δέ; "it is obvious that πλήν was the regular word in the vulgar language": Bl., § 77, 13), yet, howbeit, only: [[matthew 11 22|Mat.11:22, 24 18:7 26:39, 64]] (M, Pr., 86), [[luke 6 24|Luk.6:24, 35 10:11, 14 10:20 11:41 12:31 13:33 17:1 18:8 19:27 22:21-22, 42]] (WH, mg. om.) [[luke 23 28|Luk.23:28]], [[1-corinthians 11 11|1Co.11:11]], [[ephesians 5 33|Eph.5:33]], [[philippians 3 16|Php.3:16 4:14]], [[revelation 2 25|Rev.2:25]]; π. ὅτι (Hdt., Plat., al.), except that, save that, [[acts 20 23|Act.20:23]], [[philippians 1 18|Php.1:18]]. 2. As prep., with genitive, except, save (cl.) : [[mark 12 32|Mrk.12:32]], [[john 8 10|Jhn.8:10]], [[acts 8 1|Act.8:1 15:28 27:22]].† (AS)

πλήρης, -ες [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא ;] 1. full, filled: [[matthew 14 20|Mat.14:20 15:37]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[mark 8 19|Mrk.8:19;]] λέπρας, [[luke 5 12|Luk.5:12;]] metaphorically, of the soul: πνεύματος ἀγίου, [[luke 4 1|Luk.4:1]], [[acts 6 3|Act.6:3 7:55 11:24]]; πίστεως, [[acts 6 5|Act.6:5;]] χάριτος, ib. [[acts 6 8|Act.6:8;]] χ. καὶ ἀληθείας (where π. is indecl.; see M, Pr., 50; Milligan, NTD, 65, with reff. in each), [[john 1 14|Jhn.1:14;]] δόλου, [[acts 13 10|Act.13:10;]] θυμοῦ, [[acts 19 28|Act.19:28;]] ἔργων ἀγαθῶν, [[acts 9 36|Act.9:36.]] 2. full, complete: μισθός, II Jn 8; σῖτος (π. prob. in­decl. here; see on [[john 1 14|Jhn.1:14]], supr.), [[mark 4 28|Mrk.4:28.]]† (AS)

πληροφορέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 8 11|Ecc.8:11]] (מָלֵא) * ;] 1. to bring in full measure, hence, to fulfil, accomplish: [[luke 1 1|Luk.1:1]], [[2-timothy 4 5|2Ti.4:5 4:17]]. 2. to persuade, assure or satisfy fully (so in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 82 f.; M, Th., 9): pass., [[romans 4 21|Rom.4:21 14:5]], [[colossians 4 12|Col.4:12]] (see Lft., in l). 3. to fill: [[romans 15 13|Rom.15:13]], L, mg. (Cl. Ro., [[1-corinthians 5 4|1Co.5:4]]); metaphorically, pass., to be filled with, hence, fully bent on (Ec, l.with).† (AS)

πληροφορία, -ας, ἡ (πληροφορέω), full assurance, confidence: [[1-thessalonians 1 5|1Th.1:5;]] τ. συνέσεως, [[colossians 2 2|Col.2:2;]] τ. ἐλπίδος, [[hebrews 6 11|Heb.6:11;]] πίστεως, [[hebrews 10 22|Heb.10:22]] (cf. Lft. on Col., l.with; M, Th., 9).† (AS)

πληρόω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא ;] 1. to fill, make full, fill to the full, with accusative; (a) of things : pass. (σαψήνη, φάραγξ), [[matthew 13 48|Mat.13:48]], [[luke 3 5|Luk.3:5]]" (LXX) ; figuratively, [[matthew 23 32|Mat.23:32;]] but chiefly of immaterial things: πᾶσαν χρείαν, [[philippians 4 19|Php.4:19;]] ἦχος ἐλήρωσε τ. οἶκον, [[acts 2 2|Act.2:2;]] with genitive of thing(s) (cl.), [[acts 5 28|Act.5:28;]] pass., before ἐκ, [[john 12 3|Jhn.12:3]] (cf. B1., § 36, 4); π. τ. καρδίαν, [[john 16 6|Jhn.16:6]], [[acts 5 3|Act.5:3]]; metaphorically, of the all-pervading activity of Christ, [[ephesians 4 10|Eph.4:10;]] mid., [[ephesians 1 23|Eph.1:23;]] (b) of persons: to fill with, cause to abound in : with genitive of thing(s) (cl.), [[acts 2 28|Act.2:28]] (LXX), [[romans 15 13|Rom.15:13;]] pass., to be filled with, abound in: [[ephesians 3 19|Eph.3:19]], [[philippians 4 18|Php.4:18]]; with genitive of thing(s) (cl.), [[acts 13 52|Act.13:52]], [[romans 15 14|Rom.15:14]], [[2-timothy 1 4|2Ti.1:4]]; with dative (Æsch., al.), [[luke 2 40|Luk.2:40]] (with genitive, T), [[romans 1 29|Rom.1:29]], [[2-corinthians 7 4|2Co.7:4]]; with accusative (so in π., see MM, xx), [[philippians 1 11|Php.1:11]], [[colossians 1 9|Col.1:9]]; before ἐν, [[ephesians 5 18|Eph.5:18]], [[colossians 2 10|Col.2:10]]. 2. to complete; (a) to complete, fulfil: of number, [[revelation 6 11|Rev.6:11]], WH, tat.; of time (MM, xx), [[mark 1 15|Mrk.1:15]], [[luke 21 24|Luk.21:24]], [[john 7 8|Jhn.7:8]], [[acts 7 23|Act.7:23, 30 9:23 24:27]]; ἐυδοκίαν, [[2-thessalonians 1 11|2Th.1:11;]] τ. χαράν, [[philippians 2 2|Php.2:2;]] pass., [[john 3 29|Jhn.3:29 15:11 16:24 17:13]], [[1-john 1 4|1Jn.1:4]], 2Jn.12; τ. ἔργα, [[revelation 3 2|Rev.3:2;]] ἡ ὑπακυή, [[2-corinthians 10 6|2Co.10:6;]] τ. πάσχα, [[luke 22 16|Luk.22:16;]] (b) to execute, accomplish, carry out to the full: [[matthew 3 15|Mat.3:15]], [[luke 7 1|Luk.7:1 9:31]], [[acts 12 25|Act.12:25 13:25 14:26 19:21]], [[romans 8 4|Rom.8:4 13:8 15:19]], [[galatians 5 14|Gal.5:14]], [[colossians 1 25|Col.1:25 4:17]], [[revelation 6 11|Rev.6:11]], T, WH, R, mg.; (with) of sayings, prophecies, etc., to bring to pass, fulfil: [[matthew 1 22|Mat.1:22 2:15, 17 2:23 4:14 5:17 8:17 12:17 13:35 21:4 26:54, 56 27:9]], [[mark 14 49|Mrk.14:49 15:28]] (WH, R, txt. om.), [[luke 1 20|Luk.1:20 4:21 24:44]], [[john 12 38|Jhn.12:38 13:18 15:25 17:12 18:9, 32 19:24, 36]], [[acts 1 16|Act.1:16 3:18 13:27]], [[james 2 23|Jas.2:23]] (cf. Lft., Col., 255 ff.).† (AS)

πλήρωμα, -τος, τό (πληρόω), [in LXX for מְלֹא ;] the result of the action involved in πληρόω (Lft., Col., 255 if.; AR, Eph., 255 ff.), hence, 1. in passive sense, that which has been completed, complement, plenitude, fullness (in Xen., Luc., Polyb., al., of a ship's crew or cargo, and by meton. of the ship itself) : [[john 1 16|Jhn.1:16]], [[romans 11 12|Rom.11:12, 25 15:29]], [[1-corinthians 10 26|1Co.10:26]]" (LXX) [[ephesians 1 23|Eph.1:23]] (AR, 42 ff.) [[ephesians 3 19|Eph.3:19]] (AR. 87 ff.) [[ephesians 4 13|Eph.4:13]], [[colossians 1 19|Col.1:19 2:9]]; of time, [[galatians 4 4|Gal.4:4]], [[ephesians 1 10|Eph.1:10]]; κοφίνων (σφυρίδων) πληρώματα, basketfuls, [[mark 6 43|Mrk.6:43 8:20]]. 2. In active sense (= πλήρωσις, as frequently in words of these formations, cf. κτίσις, and see MM, xx); (a) that which fills up (but see Lft., l.with) : [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16]], [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21]]; (b) a filling up, completing, fulfilment: [[romans 13 10|Rom.13:10.]]† (AS)

πλησίος, -α, -ον (πέλας, near), near, close by, neighbouring. As adv., πλησίον = πέλας, near: with genitive, [[john 4 5|Jhn.4:5;]] with art., ὁ π., one's neigh­bour [in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ ]: [[luke 10 29|Luk.10:29, 36]], [[acts 7 27|Act.7:27]], [[romans 13 10|Rom.13:10 15:2]], [[ephesians 4 25|Eph.4:25]], [[james 4 12|Jas.4:12]]; ἀγαπήσεις τὸν π. σου ὡς σεαυτόν ([[leviticus 19 18|Lev.19:18]], LXX), [[matthew 5 43|Mat.5:43 19:19 22:39]], [[mark 12 31|Mrk.12:31, 33]], [[luke 10 27|Luk.10:27]], [[romans 13 9|Rom.13:9]], [[galatians 5 14|Gal.5:14]], [[james 2 8|Jas.2:8]] (on the various senses of ὁ π. in OT, NT, see DB, iii, 511; DCC, ii, 240 f.).† (AS)

πλησμονή, -ῆς, ἡ (πίμπλημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂבֵעַ and cognate forms ;] a filling up, satiety: πρὸς π. σαρκός (RV, against the indulgence of the flesh; but ICC, in l, for the full satisfaction of the flesh, op. cit., 276 ff.), [[colossians 2 23|Col.2:23.]]† (AS)
πλήσσω [in LXX chiefly for נָכָה hi., ho. ;] to strike, smite: pass., [[revelation 8 12|Rev.8:12]] (cf. ἐπι, πλήσσω).† (AS)
πλοιάριον, -ου, τό (dimin. of πλοῖον), a boat: [[mark 3 9|Mrk.3:9]], [[luke 5 2|Luk.5:2]] (πλοῖα, WH, txt., R), [[john 6 22|Jhn.6:22-23]] (πλοῖα, WH) [[john 6 24|Jhn.6:24 21:8]].† (AS)

πλοῖον, -ον, τό (πλέω), [in LXX chiefly for אֳנִיָּה ;] a boat, also (= obsolete ναῦς) a ship: [[matthew 4 21|Mat.4:21-22]], and frequently in Gosp. and Ac, [[james 3 4|Jas.3:4]], [[revelation 8 9|Rev.8:9 18:19]]. (AS)
πλόος, πλούς genitive, -όου, -oῦ (and in late writers also πλοός, like νοός from νοῦς), ὁ (πλέω), [in LXX: Wis.14:1 * ;] a voyage: [[acts 21 7|Act.21:7 27:9-10]].† (AS)

πλούσιος, -α, -ον (πλοῦτος), [in LXX chiefly for עָשִׁיר ;] rich, wealthy: [[matthew 27 57|Mat.27:57]], [[luke 12 16|Luk.12:16 14:12 16:1, 19 18:23 19:2]].
